title: 1.7 Family Actions
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Say what family members are doing with está or están and five new -ando actions.
grammar_function: Family noun or pronoun + está/están + -ando action.
prerequisite: Spanish 1.1-1.6: people, family nouns, and está/están + action.
speaking_outcome: Say what family members are doing.
